text: No burning was detected on this property between October 4, 2026, and November 3, 2026. NASA’s FIRMS satellite data—spanning four sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS)—showed zero thermal anomalies within the asset’s boundaries during this period. All days were fully observable by each sensor, meaning smoke or heat signatures would have been flagged if present. However, small or short-lived fires could have gone undetected. This confirms no major burning occurred, but it doesn’t rule out minor or obscured fires entirely.
